item.text: CodeGraph says it collects only a small, anonymous telemetry set: metadata like a random machine ID, version/OS/arch/Node/CI info, plus event summaries for `install`, `index`, `usage_rollup`, and `uninstall` that record things like which commands/tools were used, which languages were indexed, and coarse counts/durations. It explicitly guarantees that it does **not** collect source code or project-derived data (file paths, filenames, repo names/URLs, symbol names, search queries), and also excludes IPs, geolocation, usernames, hostnames, emails, and environment variables; the allowlist is public and auditable, and turning telemetry off means it records nothing and makes no telemetry connection. [TELEMETRY.md](https://github.com/colbymchenry/codegraph/blob/main/TELEMETRY.md)
